notes.title: Announcement: 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' Early Access Release and Future Update Plans
notes.content:
Announcement: 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' Early Access Release and Future Update Plans
Hello, this is the 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' development team.

We are excited to announce that 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' is now available on Steam as an Early Access title! We welcome all players who are eager to enjoy our game and provide valuable feedback.

Purpose of Early Access:
Early Access allows us to communicate with players and improve the game before its full release. We aim to create a high-quality game by incorporating your valuable opinions and feedback.

Current Game Status:
Our game is currently in an unfinished state, with several features disabled. Please be aware that unexpected bugs or issues may occur during gameplay, and we appreciate your understanding.

Future Update Plans:
We plan to regularly update the game to add new features and content, fix bugs, and improve the overall quality. The following are some of the major planned updates:


 Addition of combat effects and sounds
 Introduction of job selection
 Addition of story-related content
 Inclusion of a tutorial
 Addition of new enemies


Support for additional languages, with English to be added soon
Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. Please feel free to share any thoughts or suggestions you have while playing the game.
We are committed to incorporating your input to make 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' the best game it can be.

Thank you.

The 'AGE OF PRIVATEER' development team, OverDog
